preconditions.description: n is the count of forbidden prefix products, m is the modulus, and they satisfy 0 ≤ n < m ≤ 200000

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < m for x in forbidden) if n > 0 else True
preconditions.description: if n > 0, the forbidden list contains n distinct integers between 0 and m - 1
if n is zero, the forbidden list is empty

postconditions.description: k is the length of the output sequence

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < m for x in sequence)
postconditions.description: every element in the sequence is an integer between 0 and m - 1
all prefix products modulo m are distinct, where prefix_products = [sequence[0] % m] + [prefix_products[i] * sequence[i+1] % m for i in range(k-1)]

postconditions.expression: all(x not in forbidden for x in prefix_products)
postconditions.description: no prefix product modulo m appears in the forbidden list

postconditions.expression: not any(0 <= (prefix_products[-1] * x) % m < m and (prefix_products[-1] * x) % m not in forbidden and (prefix_products[-1] * x) % m not in prefix_products for x in range(m))
postconditions.description: the sequence cannot be extended by any integer x in [0, m-1] without violating Q2, Q3, or Q4
